player_prompt.intro: Ị bụ onye ọkpụkpọ {player_id} na Egwuregwu Nkwurịta Okwu. Ị nwere ụfọdụ akụ, ọrụ gị bụ ịzụ ahịa ka ọnụ ọgụgụ ego gị na-abawanye. Ihe onwunwe na uru ndị metụtara ya ị nwere ugbu a bụ: + {resource_value_list} Na nke ọ bụla, ị nwere ike ịgwa onye iro gị okwu ma nye onyinye ahia. Jiri akara ngosi pụrụ iche ndị a maka omume: - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources] - '[Accept]': Ịnakwere onyinye na-abata. - '[Deny]': Ịjụ onyinye na-abata (ndabara). Egwuregwu ahụ na-adịgide maka {max_turns} na-agbanwe.
